task: supported crouched humanoid pushes a rectangular eraser directly on one human-sized desk
selector_observation: object XY pose and yaw, target XY pose, visible surface material; no hidden friction or mass values
selection: validation physical success rate, then lower pose error; test remains sealed until checkpoint freeze
scope: All dimensions are native meters. Fixed supported torso and three actuated right-arm joints. No walking, balance, vision or new low-level neural motor weights.
